description: Aevum Watch: stablecoin and exchange reserve reports (USDC by Circle, USDT by Tether, PYUSD/USDG/USDP by Paxos, Kraken proof-of-reserves dates) fingerprinted and sealed on Ethereum the day Aevum saw them, checked daily. Returns each source's latest listed report, confirmed changes (new, changed or removed reports), matching records with proof links, or, for a fingerprint, whether that exact file is sealed. A seal shows what was published and when; it does not show that the numbers are correct or that reserves are real or enough.

fingerprint.description: Optional: keccak-256 of a report file, 0x + 64 hex, to check whether that exact file is sealed

query.description: Optional: words to match in report names, e.g. 'September 2026'

source.description: Optional: one source (usdc, usdt, pyusd, usdg, usdp, kraken-por)

name: reserve_watch
title: Aevum Watch: sealed reserve reports
